verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major fail-open finding. Admission now requires a structurally valid, non-empty annotation block, rejects parser-discarded assertions and assumption-less assertions, and requires explicit positive support for every assertion while also checking disqualifiers. Because the current vocabulary has no positive malicious-security or dishonest-majority terms, both support tables are empty and both requirements are denied rather than inferred from absence. The focused tests cover the prior counterexamples: empty blocks, missing assumptions, missing assurance/parser discard, and absence of SemiHonest; they also include a valid structural control, so the checks are not vacuous. The shipped graph remains candidly Claimed and ExternalSignOffPending, with no detected instruction injection.
